notes.title: Caravan Update – Very Soon!
notes.notes:
🌅 Sunset Motel – Caravan Update Devlog 

We’re in the final testing phase! 🚀
That’s right — the Caravan Update is almost at the finish line. We’re doing the very last internal checks, and there’s really just a little time left before we can share it with you. ⏳💛

To celebrate, we’ve prepared a small devlog. This way, you can see not only what’s planned but also what we’re already testing in-game.

🚐 Caravan Interior Design

With brand-new furniture, flooring, and decoration options, you’ll be able to completely renovate abandoned caravans.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/87c1cec92aeb149e8b80710b34c5ee6e2c558ac2.png

🛻 Caravan Exterior Overhaul

Rusty bodies, broken windows, faded paint — restore them all and give your caravan a fresh, new look!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/ce828d00b6575ceac69421999cfa0e781455c6ae.png

🎥 Outdoor Cinema

You can now set up an open-air cinema at your motel!
Guests will enjoy movies under the stars, while you showcase your own style through decoration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/45e34261c97bf9e97646aa1dcdf71c494ed53e52.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/56d20ef98fa3835ca1b33d08642f98acf88c2fd5.png
🔧 Internal Testing & New Mechanics

Right now, the team is testing these features. From performance optimizations to fine-tuning new mechanics, we’re making sure everything runs smoothly.
In short: the update is almost here! 🚀

🎬 What’s Next

Very soon, we’ll be announcing the release date. Until then, enjoy these previews as a taste of what’s coming.

Thank you,
The Sunset Motel Team 💛

notes.title: HOTFIX #4
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Sunset Motel, dear guests! 🌅

We've rolled out a quick hotfix update to improve your stay and address a few reported issues:

🚗 Fixed the "Car Washer!" achievement – it should now unlock properly when completing the car wash task.
🗣️ Added a new "AI VOICE OFF" option to the gameplay settings. If you'd prefer a quieter stay, you can now disable the AI voice anytime you like.

As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback!
We're working on more updates, surprises, and improvements — stay tuned! 💛🛎️

notes.title: Sunset Motel's upcoming major update!
notes.notes:
Attention all guests of Sunset Motel!

🛻 Caravan Update – Full Feature Breakdown
The Sunset Motel universe is expanding — now with fully customizable caravans!
This major update brings a new layer of gameplay depth, creativity, and automation to your motel grounds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/3384418f184daaf2b0a869121ba1d1f18c7cfedf.png

🔧 Caravan System
Buy and place up to 10 caravans right across from your motel

Repair broken parts, connect electricity, and keep everything in top condition

Decorate each caravan interior with 100+ unique furniture and styles

Rent them out to guests and increase your revenue

A buffet area will be added in the middle for guest interaction

A new caravan workshop/shop will be available to buy parts and tools

🎨 Decoration
We’re bringing 30+ new assets in 3 key categories:

🪣 Paint

📜 Wallpaper

🪵 Parquet & flooring

Use them to personalize your caravan interiors with full freedom and flair!

🤖 Automation & Staff
Make your life easier with new features:

Fire extinguisher system (for safety events)

Automated staff for repairing damaged items

A remote grocery ordering machine so you never run out of supplies!

🧡 As always, thank you for your feedback and continued support! This update wouldn’t be possible without our community.

notes.title: HOTFIX #2
notes.notes:
Attention all guests of Sunset Motel!

We’ve been paying close attention to your reports and comments, and once again we’ve rolled up our sleeves to make Sunset Motel an even smoother and cozier experience. This hotfix brings several fixes to improve stability, visuals, and overall gameplay comfort. Here's what’s been addressed:

🖼️ The issue with some textures not loading properly — especially on graphics cards with 4GB VRAM — has been resolved. Your motel should now look sharp and vibrant even on limited hardware.

🍺 A bug where the bar’s UI would stay open and not close properly has been fixed. You can now serve drinks without UI clutter.

📱 An issue where the tablet wouldn’t function in certain situations has been fixed. You should now be able to interact with it reliably.

🚿 A strange bug where the bathroom would merge with the main floor layout in some rooms has been corrected. No more layout chaos!

🆘 A new feature has been added — if your character gets stuck, you can now press ESC to automatically recover and get back to the motel.

🧼 Customers getting blocked at the door when decorative carpets were placed in front of entrances? Fixed! They can now freely walk in no matter your interior design skills.

⚙️ And finally, we’ve made general performance improvements across the game to ensure smoother gameplay for all players.

Thank you once again for your continued support and feedback — it truly helps us make Sunset Motel the warmest stop on the road. 🛎️💛
Stay tuned for more features, polish, and updates soon!

notes.title: HOTFIX #1
notes.notes:
Hello Sunset Motel residents!

We’ve been closely listening to your feedback and have been working behind the scenes to fix some issues and improve your stay. Here’s what’s been addressed in this hotfix:

1. 🧳 The rare issue where the suitcase wouldn’t arrive has been fixed.  
2. 🍷 The alcohol serving task at the bar has been made more clear and user-friendly.  
3. 🍽️ A rare bug where food wasn’t being served has been resolved.  
4. 🇪🇸 Some words in the Spanish localization have been corrected.  
5. 🛠️ General optimizations were made to improve FPS in certain areas.  
6. 🚗 Fixed a bug where the car purchase button in the mechanic shop wasn’t working.  
7. 🧍‍♂️ Fixed broken customer models in medium and low graphic settings.  
8. 🌑 Corrected the overly dark shadows on medium settings.  
9. 🌿 Grass rendering issues in low settings have been resolved.  
10. 🗺️ Fixed a bug where players could get stuck outside the map by accident.

Thanks for playing and for all your helpful reports — you’re helping make Sunset Motel the coziest roadside stop in town. 🛎️💛  
Stay tuned, more improvements and features are on the way!

notes.title: Sunset Motel Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
🏨 Sunset Motel Officially Opens on April 18, 2025! 🌇

Hello Sunset Motel Residents! Are your bags packed? Got your keys ready? Because Sunset Motel is officially opening its doors on April 18, 2025! ✨
After months of development, countless cups of coffee, bug fixes, and your amazing feedback, we’re finally in the home stretch.
Now it’s time to share this world with you. 🎉

[previewyoutube=OSFobOT5-jg;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s Waiting for You?
A brand-new staff system: From bellboys to fitness coaches, your motel is more alive than ever!

New businesses: Car wash service, relaxing sauna, redesigned bar, and a customizable pool area just for your guests.

Bring nostalgia into your rooms with special quests from the antique dealer.

A packed experience with a full-featured gym and new service machines.

Enhanced decoration tools, more interactive elements, and surprise mini-games!

New languages, new details, and so much more!

💬 We’re truly grateful for your interest, feedback, and patience during the Prologue.
What makes Sunset Motel so special... is you.
This isn’t just a management game — it’s a story you helped create.
And in every corner of the motel, your presence can be felt.


🙏 With love, from Efkey Studios
Thank you for believing in us, for waiting for our game, and for always keeping the motel light on.
Now pack your bags—because check-in time at Sunset Motel is just around the corner.
Your key is ready. 🛎️✨

Sunset Motel Development Team :)

Due to an unexpected event, we are postponing the release date a little from April 16th to April 18th, but don't worry, we are coming full speed on April 18th :)

- Fixed the Directx error

Thank you, Sunset Motel Development Team :)
